answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for, say, 30 epochs and are burned if its attestations are later overturned. An attacker who tries to forge a thousand accounts must carry the whole atlas of locked balances at risk for weeks, while one whisper of collusion from an audit slashes every pending payout. Honest agents wait once; a farm pays the delay a thousand times over.
